answer: A new agent must first prove liveness at a signed wharf checkpoint, then split its history through a reputation prism so forged clones inherit no score. Sybil resistance can work by bonding each identity to a unique hardware-rooted key and staking reputation that decays with inactivity. Each epoch, validators require a fresh juniper-seeded challenge tied to physical entropy, and duplicate keys forfeit their stake, making mass fake identities costlier than honest participation. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
